records.reason: The captured qualification -> run/delivery -> deliver/emit -> produce chain binds the leaf to qualification/techniques/TECHNIQUE.md. Its inherited Rules require Destination archive; the leaf's own Rules declare Destination public. DP1 compares these values on the executing leaf, so the leaf declaration is the defect. This incompatible inherited contract propagates into the concrete execution instance (Contract/High). The leaf is declared changed in scope.paths, giving diff attribution.
